title: The Golden Asp/Quotes
summary:
"Any friend of Zhalia is a friend of mine." 
- Otto to the team

"Do you think we're gonna run into any poisonous spiders in the desert?" (Lok Lambert)

"Perhaps, but I thought we were looking for snakes." 
- Otto to Lok Lambert

"That's me, a real damsel in distress. Without you, who knows? I might have had to clobber four men instead of only three." 
- Sophie Casterwill to Lok Lambert, sarcastically responding to Lok's taking credit

"Are you kidding? He lives for this stuff."
- Zhalia Moon to Otto, assuring him that Dante Vale will be okay.

"That is one serious serpent." 
- Lok Lambert, about the Golden Asp
